title: PH39005: Electromagnetism
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1. Determination of Brewster s angle.2. Verification of Sellmeir s equation.4.
Polarisation of laser light.5. Malus Law.6. Reflection grating.7. e/m using
helical method.8. Measurement of Cauchy s constant.9. Phototransistor
characteristics.10. Lattice vibrations.11. Experiments using the Michelson
interferometer.
